title: Anglais — Lycee
rules: Test individuel et chronometre. Une seule reponse par question.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: She ___ to school every day.
questions.e: Third person singular in the present simple takes -s.

questions.q: Choose the correct past form: They ___ the film last night.
questions.e: Past simple of a regular verb: watched.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the present perfect?
questions.e: have/has + past participle forms the present perfect.

questions.q: Complete: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.e: First conditional: if + present simple, will + base form.

questions.q: Choose the correct comparative: This book is ___ than that one.
questions.e: Long adjectives form the comparative with 'more'.

questions.q: Complete: She has been teaching ___ 2015.
questions.e: 'Since' introduces a starting point in time.

questions.q: Choose the passive form of 'The teacher corrects the exercises'.
o: The exercises are corrected by the teacher
questions.e: Passive: be + past participle + by + agent.

questions.q: Complete: I wish I ___ more time.
questions.e: After 'I wish', the past simple expresses an unreal present.

questions.q: Choose the correct reported speech: He said, 'I am tired.'
o: He said he will be tired
questions.e: The present shifts to the past in reported speech.

questions.q: Choose the correct question tag: You are a teacher, ___ ?
questions.e: A positive statement takes a negative tag.

questions.q: What is the opposite of 'difficult'?
questions.e: 'Easy' is the antonym of 'difficult'.

questions.q: A person who teaches at a university is usually called a :
questions.e: 'Lecturer' designates a university teacher.

questions.q: The word 'syllabus' refers to :
questions.e: A syllabus outlines the content of a course.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: The students ___ the exam next week.
questions.e: 'To sit an exam' is the standard collocation.

questions.q: What does 'to assess' mean?
questions.e: 'Assess' means to evaluate or judge.

questions.q: The head of a secondary school in British English is the :
questions.e: 'Headmaster' or 'head teacher' leads a school.

questions.q: Choose the synonym of 'improve':
questions.e: 'Enhance' means to make better.

questions.q: A 'deadline' is :
questions.e: A deadline is the latest acceptable time.

questions.q: Which sentence is correctly punctuated?
questions.e: A direct question ends with a question mark and starts with a capital.

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelled word:
questions.e: 'i' before 'e' except after 'c'.

questions.q: Which linking word expresses contrast?
questions.e: 'However' introduces an opposing idea.

questions.q: Which linking word expresses consequence?
questions.e: 'Therefore' introduces a result.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.e: Third person negative: doesn't + base form.

questions.q: A formal letter usually ends with :
questions.e: 'Yours sincerely' closes a formal letter to a named person.

questions.q: Which word is a preposition?
questions.e: 'Between' introduces a relation of place or time.

questions.q: In English teaching, 'CEFR' levels range from :
questions.e: The Common European Framework goes from A1 to C2.

questions.q: A 'listening comprehension' activity mainly develops :
questions.e: It trains the ability to understand spoken English.

questions.q: Pair work in class is mainly used to :
questions.e: It maximises the time each learner speaks.

questions.q: Formative assessment is designed to :
o: rank students at the end of the year
questions.e: It provides feedback while learning is still in progress.

questions.q: The main aim of a communicative approach is to :
o: use the language in real situations
questions.e: It prioritises meaningful communication over rule learning.
